name: Support plan downgrade policy example
answer:
Customers can downgrade their plan at any time, and the change takes effect at the next renewal.
Customers must give 30 days notice before downgrading their plan.
Customers receive complimentary airport lounge access.

sources.title: Support Plan Downgrade Policy
sources.content:
Customers can downgrade their plan at any time, and the change takes effect at the next renewal.
Customers retain their current plan features until renewal.
Customers must give 14 days notice before downgrading their plan.
